findings.title: Hardcoded Chinese field names in FX chart configuration
findings.description: The china_fx_mid_rates series uses hardcoded Chinese field names ('美元', '欧元', '日元') directly in the component configuration. This creates inconsistency with the i18n approach used elsewhere and will display Chinese characters regardless of user locale settings.
findings.snippet:
{ slug: "china_fx_mid_rates", label: t("dashboard.keyMonitor.series.usd"), field: "美元" },
{ slug: "china_fx_mid_rates", label: t("dashboard.keyMonitor.series.eur"), field: "欧元" },
{ slug: "china_fx_mid_rates", label: t("dashboard.keyMonitor.series.jpy"), field: "日元" },
findings.suggested_issue: Create a field mapping layer that translates backend field names to locale-independent identifiers, or ensure the backend returns locale-agnostic field keys that can be mapped to display labels via i18n.

findings.title: Missing loading state for individual chart cards
findings.description: CandlestickCard and EconomicChartCard components show Empty state when data is unavailable but don't distinguish between 'loading' and 'no data' states. Users cannot tell if data is still being fetched or genuinely unavailable.
findings.suggested_issue: Add a loading prop to CandlestickCard and EconomicChartCard components. When loading is true and data is empty, show a Skeleton or Spin component instead of Empty state.

findings.title: Hardcoded 'vs prev' text not internationalized
findings.description: The EconomicChartCard displays 'vs prev' as hardcoded English text in the statistics section, bypassing the i18n system used throughout the application.
findings.suggested_issue: Replace hardcoded 'vs prev' with t('dashboard.stats.vsPrevious', { defaultValue: 'vs prev' }) to maintain i18n consistency.

findings.title: Hardcoded 'AI Insight:' prefix not internationalized
findings.description: The insight section in EconomicChartCard uses hardcoded 'AI Insight:' prefix text, which should be internationalized for non-English users.
findings.snippet:
<Typography.Text style={{ fontSize: 13, color: token.colorTextSecondary }}>
  AI Insight: {stats.insight}
</Typography.Text>
findings.suggested_issue: Replace 'AI Insight:' with t('dashboard.insight.prefix', { defaultValue: 'AI Insight' }) and use template: `${t('dashboard.insight.prefix')}: ${stats.insight}`

findings.title: Fallback insight text bypasses translation system
findings.description: When translation keys are missing, the insight fallback generates hardcoded English text instead of using the translation system's defaultValue mechanism properly.
findings.suggested_issue: Remove the fallback check and ensure all translation keys have proper defaultValue parameters. The current approach masks missing translations and produces inconsistent language output.

findings.title: MetricValue flash animation uses hardcoded color classes
findings.description: The MetricValue component uses hardcoded Tailwind classes (bg-emerald-50, bg-amber-50, text-slate-900) for flash animations that may not respect user's color scheme preferences or accessibility settings.
findings.snippet:
const flashClass = flash === "up"
  ? "bg-emerald-50 text-[var(--bullish)]"
  : flash === "down"
    ? "bg-amber-50 text-[var(--bearish)]"
    : "";
findings.suggested_issue: Use CSS custom properties consistently (e.g., var(--flash-up-bg), var(--flash-down-bg)) instead of mixing hardcoded Tailwind colors with CSS variables to ensure theme consistency.

findings.title: No visual feedback when clicking metric cards
findings.description: MarketPulse metric cards have onClick handler and cursor-pointer but lack immediate visual feedback (like a pressed state) when clicked, making the interaction feel unresponsive.
findings.snippet:
<div 
  className="flex flex-col h-full px-4 py-3 transition-all duration-300 cursor-pointer hover:bg-slate-50 group border-l border-[var(--border)] first:border-l-0"
  onClick={() => onMetricClick?.(metric.key)}
>
findings.suggested_issue: Add active:scale-[0.98] or active:bg-slate-100 class to provide immediate tactile feedback when the metric card is clicked.

findings.title: Empty state shows generic message without actionable guidance
findings.description: When GlobalSentimentTrend has no data, it renders an empty chart area without any Empty component or guidance message, leaving users confused about why no data appears.
findings.suggested_issue: Add an Empty component with a descriptive message when data is unavailable: `if (!data || data.length === 0) return <Empty description={t('dashboard.sentiment.noData')} />;`

findings.title: Arrow icon shown even when percent change is zero
findings.description: In EconomicChartCard, when percentChange is exactly 0, the component still shows ArrowDownOutlined icon instead of a neutral indicator, which could mislead users.
findings.suggested_issue: Add a third condition for zero change: `{stats.percentChange > 0 ? <ArrowUpOutlined /> : stats.percentChange < 0 ? <ArrowDownOutlined /> : <MinusOutlined />}`

findings.title: Subscription error message lacks user-friendly context
findings.description: When WebSocket subscription fails in AnalysisStream, the raw error message is displayed directly to users without sanitization or user-friendly explanation.
findings.suggested_issue: Sanitize technical error messages before display. Map common error patterns to user-friendly messages (e.g., 'Connection refused' -> 'Unable to connect to server. Please check your network.').

findings.title: ChartStateBanner empty state lacks retry action
findings.description: When chart state is 'empty', the ChartStateBanner shows a message to expand the range but doesn't provide a direct action button to do so, requiring users to manually find and use the TimeRangeControls.
findings.suggested_issue: Add an actionLabel and onAction prop to the empty state that triggers the time range expansion, or provide a link/button to scroll to TimeRangeControls.

findings.title: Skeleton loading state lacks visual hierarchy
findings.description: The initial loading skeleton in KeyMonitorPage uses a generic Skeleton with 10 rows, which doesn't match the actual layout structure (3 cards in a row, then charts below), creating a jarring transition when content loads.
findings.suggested_issue: Create a layout-aware skeleton that mirrors the actual content structure: 3 card skeletons in a row followed by chart-shaped skeletons, providing a smoother visual transition.
